purpose: Determine whether nonpositive species medians that blocked the predeclared log-scale sensitivity reflect biologically impossible/raw-data coding problems, without changing or recomputing any phylogenetic-memory effect in Stage A.

scope.audit_population: All 201 frozen family x trait systems are re-queried under the exact BIEN 4.2.8 extraction contract; reporting focuses on species with median <= 0 and their systems.

semantic_domain.rule: For these physical size/mass traits, a species-level median <= 0 is biologically outside the admissible measurement domain and is audited as a data-validity problem rather than a legitimate log-scale value.
semantic_domain.note: This rule is fixed from trait semantics before opening raw audit results.

exact_extraction_contract.numeric_rule: trait_value::text must match the same numeric regular expression used by run_trait_memory_real_effect_v0_7.R / run_trait_memory_robust_system_v0_3.R
exact_extraction_contract.species_state: median numeric trait_value across admitted raw records

classifications.ZERO_MEDIAN_ALL_ZERO: species median = 0 and all numeric records = 0
classifications.ZERO_MEDIAN_MIXED: species median = 0 and at least one numeric record != 0
classifications.POSITIVE_MEDIAN_WITH_NONPOSITIVE_RAW: species median > 0 but at least one raw numeric record <= 0; reported as a secondary contamination indicator
classifications.CLEAN_POSITIVE: species median > 0 and all raw numeric records > 0

system_level_outputs: number and fraction of species with median <=0
number and fraction of raw records <=0
source and source-citation concentration of nonpositive records

decision_rules.confirmed_invalid_data: Any median <=0 in the predeclared positive-only traits is classified as invalid by semantic domain. Raw-record provenance determines likely mechanism (zero placeholder, negative coding, unit mixing, or source-specific contamination).
decision_rules.stage_B_trigger: Stage B impact sensitivity may be designed only after Stage A is complete. Its cleaning rule must be based solely on Stage A data-validity classification, not on changes in rho or manuscript conclusions.
decision_rules.no_trigger_if_none: If Stage A finds that affected values are valid under a documented trait definition, no cleaning sensitivity is run and the log HOLD remains.

stop_rule: No rho, R_family, portability gain, null p-value, or manuscript conclusion is inspected to choose Stage A validity rules.
No offset, pseudocount, signed log, winsorization, value replacement, source deletion, or trait-specific threshold is allowed in Stage A.
No source/citation is removed because its exclusion improves the result.
Any Stage B analysis requires a new frozen design before its outcome is opened.

tree_membership_annotation.purpose: Determine whether invalid/nonpositive species medians actually entered the primary S3 or prune-only rho inputs, without recomputing rho.
tree_membership_annotation.trigger: For every family x trait system with at least one species median <=0 in the all-201 raw audit, reconstruct the frozen V.PhyloMaker2 crosswalk and annotate each audited species as in_S3 and in_prune_only.

technical_amendment.reason: Added predeclared tree-membership annotation so the audit can distinguish biologically invalid raw medians that actually entered the frozen S3/prune effect inputs from invalid records excluded by the phylogenetic crosswalk. No rho or downstream statistic is recomputed.

raw_record_outputs: For systems containing at least one species median <=0, aggregate all admitted raw records by family, trait, unit, source and source_citation with negative/zero/positive counts.
For every admitted raw value <=0 in those systems, aggregate exact numeric value x unit x source x source_citation frequency.
No raw-record deletion or replacement is performed.

technical_amendment_raw_provenance.reason: Added exact nonpositive raw-value frequency and denominator summaries by unit/source/citation so placeholder coding, unit problems, and source-specific contamination can be distinguished without changing any memory effect.

reference_identity_gate.rule: After BIEN re-query and frozen V.PhyloMaker2 membership reconstruction, S3_n_nonpositive and prune_n_nonpositive must match the v0.3 robustness artifact for every one of the 201 systems exactly.

technical_amendment_identity.reason: Added exact per-system identity gate against the v0.3 robustness artifact so raw-value audit results are interpreted only if the re-queried species medians and frozen tree memberships reproduce the original nonpositive counts.

technical_amendment_query_staging.observed_runtime_only: The first audit execution remained inside the initial all-201 server-side aggregation for more than 12 minutes and had produced no audit artifact or interpretable outcome.
technical_amendment_query_staging.change: Split the same audit into (1) an all-201 species-median/sign/unit query without source/citation string aggregation, followed by (2) source/citation provenance queries only for family x trait systems containing at least one raw nonpositive record. All filters, medians, classification rules, identity gates and outputs are unchanged.
technical_amendment_query_staging.reason: Avoid unnecessary source/citation aggregation over clean systems while preserving the frozen Stage A estimand and audit population.
